title: Align arbitrary equality satisfaction with resolution
body:
## Summary

We resolve `package===1` to version `1.0.0`, but satisfaction checks compare rendered versions and report the installed package as incompatible. Compare parsed versions for `===` so installation reuse and `uv pip check` agree with resolution.

Local version labels remain significant: `===1` accepts `1.0.0` but rejects `1.0.0+local`.

Prerequisite for #21930.
